title: [Installer] Per-user upgrades plan related bundles twice and leave broken uninstall entries
summary: The report contains unusually detailed upgrade logs and a concrete proposed direction, and a maintainer supplied a feasible BAFunctions mitigation. However, the latest triage request asks the issue author to attach a valid bug report, and there is no subsequent author response. Preserve the author-feedback gate rather than treating the proposed mechanism as a confirmed root cause.

comment.body: The reproduction details and Burn log excerpts are useful. Before implementation work starts, please attach a newly generated PowerToys bug report ZIP captured immediately after reproducing the failed per-user upgrade. Please also include the exact source and target PowerToys versions, whether the installation is per-user or per-machine, and the complete bootstrapper log covering detection, planning, apply, and rollback. The report should be a valid PowerToys diagnostic archive without oversized or malformed entries.
